content.text: {"page":"Forms","components":[{"id":"7:37","name":"IP / Form Field","description":"Instapage: form field, built in the Form Builder (Assets &gt; Forms). Types: predefined (first/last name, email, phone, website, company, job title, address, city, state/region, industry, company size, country, gender, marital status) or custom (single-line text, dropdown, checkbox, radio, GDPR/terms checkbox with links, hidden). Required on/off, asterisk separately. Field order, labels and required state come from the packet and approved copy: report any mismatch, never resolve it. Form text uses the paragraph family at a fixed size. Unstyled primitive: field and button appearance (radius, fills, borders, button font and hover) come from the client layer, within what the Instapage form builder allows.","documentationLinks":[{"uri":"https://help.instapage.com/hc/en-us/articles/24174660478999-The-Form-Builder-and-Form-Library"}]},{"id":"7:6","name":"Type=Text","description":"","documentationLinks":[]},{"id":"7:10","name":"Type=Email","description":"","documentationLinks":[]},{"id":"7:14","name":"Type=Phone","description":"","documentationLinks":[]},{"id":"7:18","name":"Type=Dropdown","description":"","documentationLinks":[]},{"id":"7:23","name":"Type=Checkbox","description":"","documentationLinks":[]},{"id":"7:26","name":"Type=Radio","description":"","documentationLinks":[]},{"id":"7:29","name":"Type=Consent","description":"","documentationLinks":[]},{"id":"7:32","name":"Type=Hidden","description":"","documentationLinks":[]},{"id":"7:45","name":"IP / Form Submit","description":"Instapage: the form's submit button. Text = approved CTA wording, exact; aria-label from WordSmither. Instapage lets it take corner radius, font, colors and hover, fixed size, drop shadow and border. Unstyled primitive: field and button appearance (radius, fills, borders, button font and hover) come from the client layer, within what the Instapage form builder allows.","documentationLinks":[{"uri":"https://help.instapage.com/hc/en-us/articles/24174660478999-The-Form-Builder-and-Form-Library"}]},{"id":"7:50","name":"IP / Form","description":"Instapage: native form from the Form Library, on the page or in a popup. After submit: redirect (Instapage page or outside URL) OR file download, not both; optional URL parameters; thank-you message (exact approved copy) or none. Integrations: Form Integrations (CRM) and Lead Notifications per page. Conversion goal &quot;Form submissions&quot; counts native forms only. No native conditional logic. Submissions test only on a published URL. Unstyled primitive: field and button appearance (radius, fills, borders, button font and hover) come from the client layer, within what the Instapage form builder allows.","documentationLinks":[{"uri":"https://help.instapage.com/hc/en-us/articles/206828587-How-to-add-a-form-to-your-page"}]}],"texts":[],"annotations":[]}
